content.text: All preferred elements are present in § 20. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote:
20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">§ 20 meets the preferred position in full. Vendor expressly defends, indemnifies and holds harmless Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims relating to the Services or Deliverables (20.1), and against claims arising from Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). Standard procedure is present — prompt notice, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, and control of the defence, with a settlement-consent protection (20.4). Customer's reciprocal indemnity is narrow: unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized, and Customer's violation of Applicable Law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions (20.3). Beyond preferred, 20.5 gives procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims so the indemnity is not squeezed by the liability cap (no super-cap needed, and the fallback 3× cap would be less favourable to us). No redline required.</rationale>
